title: Comparison of the road signs of the Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals between the 2006 consolidated version and the 2023 revision

2006.document: Convention on Road Signs and Signals, consolidated version 2006 (Conv_road_signs_2006v_EN.pdf)
2006.numbering: Section letter + symbol number, e.g. "A, 1a", "C, 3a". For danger warning signs the model is prefixed: "Aa" (triangle) or "Ab" (square set on a diagonal).

2023.numbering: Section letter + two-digit paragraph + variant, e.g. "A-01.1", "C-03.14".

legend.legacy_ids: All 2006 numbers the sign corresponds to (model-specific numbers appear per variant in legacy_id).
legend.symbol_may_be_reversed: True when the 2023 text allows the symbol to be reversed (e.g. for traffic keeping to the left).
legend.variants: One entry per distinct rendering allowed by the texts. Every entry carries the same set of labels so variants can be filtered uniformly.
legend.variant.versions: Which version(s) of the Convention allow this rendering.
legend.variant.model: Danger warning signs only: model "one" (triangle) or "two" (square on a diagonal); 2006 names them Aa / Ab (legacy_model).
legend.variant.legacy_id: 2006 number for this rendering; null when there is no 2006 equivalent.
legend.variant.border_color: Border or rim colour; null when there is none. For F signs it is the white inner square.
legend.variant.symbol_color: Colour of the symbol or inscription; null when the sign bears none.
legend.variant.band: Cancellation band (end of a prohibition / obligation / area): "none", "single_band" (one oblique band, e.g. France) or "parallel_lines" (several parallel lines forming the band, e.g. Germany; stated as preferable in 2023). Slopes downwards from right to left.
legend.variant.prohibition_bar: Red oblique bar marking a prohibition (slopes downwards from left to right): "with_bar", "without_bar", or null when not applicable.
legend.variant.bar_continuity: "interrupted" (bar broken where it crosses the symbol) or "continuous" (2006 option); null when not applicable.
legend.removed: 2006 signs that have no counterpart in the 2023 revision.
